task.title: Migrate your own DITA
task.shortdesc: Upload a .zip of DITA and get back MyST Markdown for Sphinx, with a report that names every difference from your published DITA. No sign-in is needed.

prereq.p: A .zip of up to 10 MB with your root map, its topics, key maps, DITAVAL files and images, in the folders they use. Topics must use the OASIS DITA DTDs; files that declare entities are refused.

step.cmd: Choose your .zip and, if it holds more than one map, type the root map's path inside it.

stepresult.p: The run page shows each stage as it runs: unpack, inventory, convert, restore, check, links and report.

step.cmd: When the run finishes, select Download docs as code (.zip).

info.p: The download holds the Sphinx project in myst, the report, the redirects for old URLs, and a README that lists every topic that isn't clean and why.

result.p: Topics that pass every check are ready to merge. A topic that failed a check, or needs a writer, is still in the download; the report shows exactly what differs, so nothing is lost without you knowing.
